summary: The #36 guard works: the live budget line renders and the guarded code no longer throws. The 'no more ellipses' goal is only partly met, because the activity panel still ends a long entry with '...'. Name labels are still clipped at the viewport edges.

findings.what: The activity panel still truncates with an ellipsis. The 'review: tester: 1 problems; The host's suite could not run ... all 8 existing tests plus my new one pass. ...' entry is cut at 3 lines and ends in '...'. The session goal and journal claim there are no more ellipses.
findings.where: dashboard.jl:283 (wrap_text(l, 52; maxlines = 3) for activity); the Sprout panel, top right
findings.evidence: world/reviews/s11.png, activity block, 4th line from the 'ended (end_turn)' entry
findings.suggestion: Raise maxlines for review lines, or shorten the review summary at the source. Or show '+N more' the way the todos do, and say honestly that long entries are still clipped.

findings.what: Creature name labels are clipped at the edges of the 3D view. 'Sir Sniffsalot' is cut off by the top edge and reads 'Sir Sniffsal'. The tester also reported 'Pickles' clipped on the right. This was reported, and no todo was done for it in this session.
findings.where: name label placement in the 3D view
findings.evidence: world/reviews/s11.png, top centre; tester report for session 11
findings.suggestion: Clamp each label's screen position so the whole text box stays inside the viewport (using the text width), or hide labels that cannot fit.

findings.what: #36 was marked done without a live reproduction or a regression test for the missing-budget path. The author notes that the game was not running. The tester confirmed the budget line live, and only one old 'frame failed' event exists in the log (before the fix). The tokens_day guard also hides the whole budget line, with no log entry, whenever any one key is missing.
findings.evidence: events log has 1 tokens_day entry; the live screenshot shows the budget line
findings.suggestion: Add a unit test that calls update_dashboard! with a budget Dict that is missing keys. Consider fixing the host writer to write the file atomically, so the race goes away.

findings.what: Performance is fine. Frame median is 0.6 ms and p95 is 1.44 ms. The panels system has p95 1.43 ms, well below 33 ms. The screenshot, at 76 ms, is a live-call cost only.
